funding_causality_policy: Public funding events are aligned to OHLCV bars with ffill only after the event timestamp, then shifted one decision bar. Funding is never backfilled into earlier bars and never represents account-specific funding cashflows.
hypothesis: A causal time-series momentum strategy with volatility-targeted sizing and public funding throttles can be falsified under research-grade walk-forward validation.
